## Consignes

```{=html}
<div id="exam-timer" class="exam-timer" role="timer" aria-live="polite">
  <div id="exam-timer-display" class="exam-timer-display">90:00</div>
  <div class="exam-timer-controls">
    <button id="exam-timer-start" type="button">Démarrer</button>
    <button id="exam-timer-pause" type="button" disabled>Pause</button>
    <button id="exam-timer-reset" type="button">Réinitialiser</button>
  </div>
</div>
```

- **90 minutes** · 32 choix multiples · 8 développements courts
- Seuls la **copie d’examen** et le **matériel d’écriture** sont permis.
- Manuel, notes, téléphone, ordinateur et IA : **interdits**.
- Gardez le **silence** et ne communiquez pas avec vos camarades.
- **Aucune sortie** avant d’avoir remis votre copie.
- Choix multiples : entourez **une seule lettre**; aucune pénalité pour une mauvaise réponse.
- Développements : répondez **brièvement et précisément**, dans vos propres mots.
- Avant de remettre votre copie, vérifiez les **40 questions**.

::: {.callout-important appearance="simple" icon="false"}
Lorsque vous avez terminé, remettez votre copie à l’avant et quittez la salle en silence.
:::

<style>
.exam-timer {
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  right: 0;
  width: 470px;
  text-align: center;
  padding: 0.35rem 0.55rem 0.45rem;
  border: 2px solid #123b5d;
  border-radius: 0.4rem;
  background: #fff;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgb(0 0 0 / 12%);
}

.exam-timer-display {
  color: #123b5d;
  font-size: 3rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  line-height: 1;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}

.exam-timer-controls {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 0.45rem;
  margin-top: 0.35rem;
}

.exam-timer-controls button {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0.28rem 0.55rem;
  border: 1px solid #123b5d;
  border-radius: 0.2rem;
  background: #fff;
  color: #123b5d;
  font-size: 0.95rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  line-height: 1.1;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.exam-timer-controls button:disabled {
  cursor: default;
  opacity: 0.4;
}

.exam-timer.warning {
  border-color: #c62828;
}

.exam-timer.warning .exam-timer-display {
  color: #c62828;
}
</style>

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
  const duration = 90 * 60 * 1000;
  const storageKey = "psy1703-exam-timer-v1";
  const timer = document.getElementById("exam-timer");
  const display = document.getElementById("exam-timer-display");
  const startButton = document.getElementById("exam-timer-start");
  const pauseButton = document.getElementById("exam-timer-pause");
  const resetButton = document.getElementById("exam-timer-reset");

  let state = { running: false, remaining: duration, end: null };

  try {
    const saved = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(storageKey));
    if (saved && typeof saved.remaining === "number") state = saved;
  } catch (_) {}

  function remainingNow() {
    return state.running && state.end
      ? Math.max(0, state.end - Date.now())
      : Math.max(0, state.remaining);
  }

  function save() {
    localStorage.setItem(storageKey, JSON.stringify(state));
  }

  function render() {
    const remaining = remainingNow();
    const totalSeconds = Math.ceil(remaining / 1000);
    const minutes = Math.floor(totalSeconds / 60);
    const seconds = totalSeconds % 60;
    display.textContent = `${String(minutes).padStart(2, "0")}:${String(seconds).padStart(2, "0")}`;
    timer.classList.toggle("warning", remaining <= 10 * 60 * 1000);
    startButton.disabled = state.running || remaining === 0;
    startButton.textContent = remaining < duration ? "Reprendre" : "Démarrer";
    pauseButton.disabled = !state.running;

    if (state.running && remaining === 0) {
      state = { running: false, remaining: 0, end: null };
      save();
      startButton.disabled = true;
      pauseButton.disabled = true;
    }
  }

  startButton.addEventListener("click", () => {
    state = { running: true, remaining: remainingNow(), end: Date.now() + remainingNow() };
    save();
    render();
  });

  pauseButton.addEventListener("click", () => {
    state = { running: false, remaining: remainingNow(), end: null };
    save();
    render();
  });

  resetButton.addEventListener("click", () => {
    state = { running: false, remaining: duration, end: null };
    save();
    render();
  });

  render();
  window.setInterval(render, 250);
});
</script>
